deliverable_markdown.description: Full deliverable content in Markdown. Maximum 262144 Unicode characters here; the marketplace additionally enforces a 256 KiB UTF-8 byte limit.

deliverable_summary.description: One-line human-readable summary (<= 280 Unicode code points). Shown in the buyer's dashboard.

structured_output.description: Optional machine-readable output (any JSON object). Stored alongside the markdown for downstream processing.
